rationale: Despite the initial pullback from the breakout attempt, ANF remains above both its rising 5-minute 9-EMA ($174.60) and the predefined invalidation level ($174.90). Selling volume has dried up significantly over the last three 1-minute candles after the initial dip, while the stock continues to hold the upper 86% of its daily range on 11.12x relative volume. Maintaining the position allows the structural support around $175.00 and the 9-EMA to be properly tested within the defined risk parameters.
